subject.title: [Feature]: Add realtime video frame transport for provider and gateway relay sessions

question: Should OpenClaw accept a gateway/provider-level realtime video-frame transport for Talk relay sessions, and what consent, validation, payload, logging/redaction, and provider-retention constraints must that public SDK/RPC contract enforce?
rationale: This crosses camera privacy, gateway protocol, provider routing, and public Plugin SDK boundaries, so automation cannot safely choose the product and security contract.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded gateway contract
options.body: Approve a one-shot frame transport only after explicit consent, MIME/size validation, redaction/logging rules, provider mappings, docs, and relay tests are defined.

options.title: Keep browser-direct only
options.body: Reject gateway-carried image frames for now and keep visual context limited to browser-owned provider-direct transports.

options.title: Defer to plugin experiments
options.body: Let external providers experiment with private seams until a missing core API and stable security model are clearer.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded gateway contract
recommendation.body: Approve a one-shot frame transport only after explicit consent, MIME/size validation, redaction/logging rules, provider mappings, docs, and relay tests are defined.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is the current issue assignee and has adjacent Talk/provider/runtime history.
